grading_policy.Correct: Every requested material part resolved correctly without material contradiction.
grading_policy.Partial: Material omission or unresolved wording, without an explicit material contrary ruling.
grading_policy.Incorrect: An explicit material wrong ruling; this takes precedence over omissions.
grading_policy.scope: Each answer stands alone; no borrowing across questions or readers. No confidence grading. Equivalent wording accepted. Only requested material parts are required. Unsupported correct guesses are flagged separately.
grading_policy.support_boundary: Read only the five hashed input files. No outside rulebook or prior adjudication was needed.

scope_notes: Q007 “discard fatigue” is accepted as equivalent removal wording: it follows the supplied snapshot’s own catastrophic-failure instruction, and no alternative fatigue destination is asserted.
Q002 wording is assessed against the question’s eligibility/order/display requests; neither reader asserts that an eligible player can reserve a card or skip the display procedure.
Q014 does not separately ask when Company failure triggers; reader A is not downgraded for omitting the failure threshold.
Q020 asks funding/calculation and failure consequences, not inter-firm Revenue order; its omission is not required merely because the key includes it.
Q016 reader A omits returning the Opposition Leader token, but resolves the asked Prime Minister transfer and effect order; that unasked component-handling detail is not required.
Q019 reciprocal Company refilling is part of the requested repeat-filled revenue procedure and is required within Q019 itself.
